en.title: ETSI TS 119 472-2: VC-03 cites an example of RFC 9901 for Compact Serialization
en.summary: EAAP-SD-JWT VC-03 cites clause 5.2 of RFC 9901 for Compact Serialization. That clause is a non-normative presentation example. The format is specified in clause 4.
en.impact: A reader who follows the reference reaches an example in place of the format rules.
